title: WorkPulse overtime.requested v1
description: An overtime request was submitted and is awaiting the manager step. Identifiers, the work date and hours only — the free-text reason is PII and never leaves the database (`.ai/security.md`).

employee_id.description: Employee the request belongs to (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).

work_date.description: The single day the overtime was worked (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

hours.description: Requested overtime hours as a JSON number (ADR 0017); 0 < hours <= 12 with at most 2 decimal places, enforced by the API. A count, never an amount.
